pick.intro: Opening line of the dialog: {files} = the file name or «N files», {samples} = total number of samples in them.
pick.file: Caption of the sample table of one file: {name} = file name, {n} = samples in it, {size} = their size, already formatted (e.g. 12 MB).
pick.table: Accessible name of the sample table: {name} = file name.
pick.sel: Live status under the table: {n} = samples ticked, {total} = all samples, {size} = about how much is read, already formatted.
pick.ids.bad: The typed sample numbers are not a list: {text} = what was typed.
pick.ids.unknown: A file lacks a typed sample number: {missing} = the numbers it lacks, {ids} = the numbers it has.
pick.cancelled: Note when the dialog is cancelled: {name} = the file that was not opened.
